title: The hero rises to the eye

cues.text: The tower's peak points up at the giant eye in the sky.
On the tower's top, the group lies scattered.
The hero floats up toward the eye.
The eye's red rim fills the sky.
He drifts through a storm of colour toward a blinding light.
He soars on, stretched out, through rushing light.
A glowing egg of light rests on cracked stone.
He dives toward it, arms raised.
His shoes step across the glowing ground.
Wings of crackling blue light spread on either side of him.
His face, calm. He looks straight ahead.
